Press Release 
October 13, 2025 

House Young Guns Condemn China’s Deliberate Attack on Philippine Coast Guard Vessel in West Philippine Sea

Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V, Deputy Speaker Jay Khonghun, Congressman Ernix Dionisio, Congressman Zia Alonto Adiong, and Congressman Rodge Gutierrez issued a unified and forceful condemnation of China’s aggressive actions following the deliberate ramming of a Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) vessel by a China Coast Guard (CCG) ship in the West Philippine Sea.

On Sunday morning, October 12, 2025, a CCG vessel intentionally collided with the BRP Cabra near Scarborough Shoal, within the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone (EEZ). The PCG ship, escorting Filipino fishermen, sustained significant damage, impairing its operational capacity. No injuries were reported, but the incident underscores China’s escalating violations of international law and threats to Philippine maritime security and fisherfolk livelihoods.

“This brazen act of aggression is a direct assault on our sovereignty and will not go unchallenged,” Deputy Speaker Ortega declared. “The West Philippine Sea is indisputably Philippine territory, affirmed by the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and the 2016 Arbitral Award, which rejected China’s unlawful claims in the South China Sea. China’s actions are not only putting the lives of our Coast Guard in danger but also affecting the livelihoods of thousands of Filipino fisherfolk who depend on these waters.”

The lawmakers urged decisive measures from the Philippine government and the international community. Congressman Ernix Dionisio called for “a formal protest to the United Nations and stronger coordination with ASEAN allies and global partners to hold China accountable.” 

Deputy Speaker Jay Khonghun emphasized, “We must bolster our naval and Coast Guard capabilities to deter further incursions. —- Hindi maaaring maging dayuhan sa ating sariling karagatan ang ating sariling mangingisda. This is a fight for national dignity. We stand united with our fisherfolk and Coast Guard in defense of our seas.”

Congressman Zia Alonto Adiong highlighted the economic toll, stating, “China’s aggression disrupts the livelihoods of coastal communities, threatening their families and our nation’s food security”. He stressed the urgent need to implement the Philippine Maritime Zones Act to reinforce the country’s legal framework for asserting sovereign rights —- “This is about securing our seas and our people’s future.”

The House Young Guns expressed full alignment with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s steadfast stance on the West Philippine Sea, where he has repeatedly affirmed that the Philippines will not back down or yield in asserting its sovereign rights amid escalating tensions with China. In recent statements, including his 2025 State of the Nation Address, the President emphasized that the country is more confident and better prepared to defend its sovereignty through strengthened alliances and diplomatic channels, while rejecting any aggression and vowing to protect Filipino interests without seeking confrontation

This attack on our vessel is an assault on our nation’s dignity,” Congressman Gutierrez concluded. “The Filipino people stand firm, and we call on peace-loving nations to join us in upholding international law and ensuring accountability,” he added. 

End.
